Welcome to our Patna Museum Tour!
Is video mein hum explore karenge Patna Museum, jise Bihar ka “Jadu Ghar” bhi kaha jata hai. Yeh museum apni ancient sculptures, Mauryan artefacts, British-era architecture, aur Buddhist relics ke liye world-famous hai.
Aaiye, humare saath dekhiye Bihar ki rich heritage, rare collections aur woh hidden gems jo Patna Museum ko ek must-visit destination banate hain!
What you’ll see in this video:
• Patna Museum ka history & architecture
• Ancient artefacts from Maurya, Gupta & Mughal period
• Famous Didarganj Yakshi statue
• Buddhist relics & rare paintings
